description: Dataset of roads in South Africa used in the modelling of biomass transportation for the BioEnergy Atlas of South Africa is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by South African Environmental Observation Network. A spatial dataset of roads in South Africa used in the modelling of biomass transportation for the BioEnergy Atlas of South Africa. This data was derived from the National Geo-spatial Information (NGI) roads dataset for the entire country and processed to remove errors within the roads network. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher South African Environmental Observation Network. Its tags are HUMAN DIMENSIONS, roads, biomass transportation. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
